courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 天文干涉儀光程控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」與「雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；天文干涉儀光程控制的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary" and "Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的薄主鏡、可變形副鏡、雷射導引星、干涉延遲線與 coudé 光譜整合；天文干涉儀光程控制則以VLTI 與 CHARA 延遲線、條紋追蹤與雷射計量如何把光程差控制在奈米等級為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on thin primaries, deformable secondary, laser guide stars, interferometric delay lines and coudé spectroscopy across four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes; Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers centres on how VLTI and CHARA delay lines, fringe tracking and laser metrology hold optical-path difference at the nanometre level, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」與「基線向量與幾何延遲」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到天文干涉儀光程控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「可見度損失預算與校正星」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes” and “Baseline vector and geometric delay”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT
history.text: ESO 於 1980 年代後期決定建造由四座 8 m 級望遠鏡組成的 VLT，並選定智利 Cerro Paranal 為站址；第一座 UT 於 1998 年取得初光，其餘三座在之後數年陸續完成，VLTI 也在 2000 年代初取得首批條紋。2016 年 UT4 的自適應光學設施以 1170 致動器可變形副鏡與四雷射導引星取得初光，使 VLT 從被動大口徑轉向以自適應光學與干涉為核心的平台。
history.textEn: ESO decided in the late 1980s to build the VLT as four 8 m class telescopes and chose Cerro Paranal in Chile as the site; the first UT saw first light in 1998, the other three followed over the next few years, and VLTI obtained its first fringes in the early 2000s. In 2016 the UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility reached first light with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and four laser guide stars, turning the VLT from a passive large-aperture facility into a platform built around adaptive optics and interferometry.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」到「多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary" through "Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
